license.notes: AGPL v3 text with 'any later version' in source headers. AGPL network-copyleft obligations are the strongest in this library.

compatibility.notes: Compatibility is not the blocker; the security rating is.

security.network_access: Yes. The bundled raw_websockets_interaction.py talks to the OBS WebSocket server, and the console can run code that opens sockets.

findings.note: assert(load(CODE_STORAGE_INIT .. code, ...)) compiles and runs dynamically supplied code.
load(obs_data_get_string(settings, '_patches'), ...) runs code stored in script settings.
FFI declarations and CreateProcessA start external processes.
A hardcoded WebSocket password is committed in the helper script. The value is deliberately not reproduced in any document.
Persistence-related strings (startup/run) appear in the console; combined with dynamic execution this raises the rating.
No base64 blobs or packed binaries were found; the risk comes from intended dynamic execution, not hiding.

approval_required_for: Downloading or using a PENDING-USER tool rated HIGH
Allowing the console to run dynamically supplied Lua code
Allowing FFI process creation and the bundled WebSocket helper
